content: Telbivudine is supplied in two forms: tablets and oral solution. Tablets: Tyzeka 600 mg tablets are white to slightly yellowish, film-coated, and ovaloid in shape. Each tablet is imprinted with LDT on one side. They are packaged in bottles containing 30 tablets (NDC 0078-0538-15) with child-resistant closures. The tablets should be stored in their original container at a controlled room temperature of 25°C (77°F), with permissible temperature excursions between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F). Oral Solution: Tyzeka oral solution is a clear, colorless to pale yellow liquid with a passion fruit flavor. Each 5 milliliters of the solution contains 100 mg of telbivudine. It is supplied in a 300 mL bottle (NDC 0078-0539-85) with a child-resistant closure and an embossed dosing cup. The dosing cup is specifically designed for measuring Tyzeka oral solution only. The oral solution should be stored in its original container at a controlled room temperature of 25°C (77°F), with permissible temperature excursions between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F). Once the bottle is opened, the solution must be used within two months. It should not be frozen. For any medical inquiries, contact 1-877-8-Tyzeka (1-877-889-9352). Ensure that this medication, as well as all other drugs, is kept out of the reach of children.
